title: Signal Detected — Rooftop Pickup
motionDescription: Kuro Signal leans lazily on a Moon City rooftop rail until a cyan carrier spark hits the headset antenna, triggering a compressed anticipation dip, an upward whip reaction with flaring hair and drawstrings, a 3/4 receiver raise, and a settled determined-curiosity hero hold.

reducedMotionAlternative.description: Crisp hero pose of Kuro Signal on the Moon City rooftop examining the glowing portable receiver with determined curiosity.

frames.actingNote: Leaning lazily on the rooftop rail, portable receiver hanging loosely at the hip, half-bored eyes scanning the Moon City skyline.
Cyan spark and ripple hit the antenna tip; knees compress into a squash dip, shoulders drop, eyes snap toward the headset.
Head snaps upright with wide surprised eyes, spiky hair and hoodie drawstrings flare upward, right hand whips up to the headset earcup.
Torso twists 3/4 left as Kuro raises the portable receiver to eye level; cyan and magenta waveforms spike on the LED screen.
Follow-through settle into leaning-in curiosity, furrowed brow, pulsing antenna rings, right hand cocked on hip.
Crisp readable silhouette examining the flickering receiver with determined curiosity; serves as fallback and reduced-motion frame.
